release_notes: The campaign's own click log joins the honest format, cloak operators get an opt-in hard signal for provider IP ranges, and the documentation is rebuilt as a publishable wiki. The Click log panel inside a campaign still rendered the pre-1.6.17 row — an unconditional "Money" badge, an always-visible "Verdict: —", no OS, browser, bot, domain or destination; it now shows the stream that took the click ("EU (regular)"), OS and browser logos with the version on hover, the bot's name, IP, the click's domain, the real destination URL and UTC on the time hover, with the SAFE badge, verdict and reason chips only for clicks a cloak stream actually judged; Barkrowler joins the known bots. New in Settings → Bots: treat a hit in the datacenter/crawler IP ranges as a hard bot signal (off by default) — Meta (AS32934) and Telegram (AS62041) reviewers coming from the providers' own published ranges carried a single soft signal and reached the money page on medium sensitivity; tick the box and any range hit goes to the safe page at any sensitivity. The docs/ tree is rewritten against the current code (half of it was stuck on 0.9-1.5): 36 wiki-ready pages, features.md slimmed to an overview, stale files archived; cli/wiki_sync.py publishes it as the GitHub wiki, cli/api_catalog.php keeps docs/api.md honest against the code (290 actions), and cli/add_antibot_stream.php adds a Bot -> 404 intercepting stream to every campaign lacking one (dry-run default, DB backup, exact rollback).
